correctness.rationale: Static classes yield exact star/triangle normal form; singleton centre-edge recolorings are isolated Kempe components; six-spoke classes form one connected Kempe chain for swapping two star labels; three disjoint triangle-spoke chains exchange a triple vertex with a sink centre; a four-stage loop swaps the triangle palette colour with a chosen centre label. Each change preserves properness and the chromatic palette. Johnson graph connectivity plus full palette permutations and internal bit toggles proves reachability for all n>=5; n=4 is three independent K2 edges. Exact enumeration and independent Kempe BFS cover n=4..6, with canonical optimum-coloring enumeration n=4..7. Finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: The proof resolves a natural qualitative reconfiguration dichotomy at the exact chromatic threshold for an unbounded family: single-vertex moves cannot change the unique triangular colour class and leave factorially many disconnected cubes, whereas no extra colour is needed for full Kempe-chain reachability. It gives explicit connectivity mechanisms at all orders n>=6 beyond the already-covered Petersen instance, rather than a routine static counting corollary.
